CIMorphologyRectangleMaximum.inputHeight.target: The height in pixels of the morphological operation. The value will be rounded to the nearest odd integer.

CIBlendWithRedMask.target: Uses values from a mask image to interpolate between an image and the background. When a mask red value is 0.0, the result is the background. When the mask red value is 1.0, the result is the image.

CISpotColor.inputContrast3.target: The contrast of the third replacement color.

CIPhotoEffectProcess.target: Apply a “Process” style effect to an image.

CIPersonSegmentation.inputQualityLevel.target: Determines the size and quality of the resulting segmentation mask. The value can be a number where 0 is accurate, 1 is balanced, and 2 is fast.

CIFastDiscBlur.target: Smooths or sharpens an image using a disc-shaped convolution kernel.

CICMYKHalftone.target: Creates a color, halftoned rendition of the source image, using cyan, magenta, yellow, and black inks over a white page.

CIDistanceGradientFromRedMask.target: Produces an infinite image where the red channel contains the distance in pixels from each pixel to the mask.

CISpotColor.inputCenterColor1.target: The center value of the first color range to replace.

CIBarsSwipeTransition.inputAngle.target: The angle in radians of the bars.

CILinearLightBlendMode.inputImage.target: The image to use as a foreground image.

CIFalseColor.inputColor1.target: The second color to use for the color ramp.

CIParallelogramTile.inputAngle.target: The angle in radians of the tiled pattern.

CIClamp.target: Clamps an image so the pixels with the specified extent are left unchanged but those at the boundary of the extent are extended outwards. CICrop.inputRectangle.target: The rectangle that specifies the crop to apply to the image.

CIDisintegrateWithMaskTransition.inputTi.target: The parametric time of the transition. This value drives the transition from start (at time 0) to end (at time 1).

CIConvolution5X5.inputBias.target: A value that is added to the RGBA components of the output pixel.

CIColorCubeWithColorSpace.inputCubeDimen.target: The dimension of the color cube.

CIBumpDistortionLinear.inputRadius.target: The radius determines how many pixels are used to create the distortion. The larger the radius, the wider the extent of the distortion.

CIColumnAverage.inputExtent.target: A rectangle that specifies the subregion of the image that you want to process.

CIAreaMinimum.target: Calculates the minimum component values for the specified area in an image, returning the result in a pixel.

CIWhitePointAdjust.inputColor.target: A color to use as the white point.

CISpotColor.inputCloseness3.target: A value that indicates how close the third color must match before it is replaced.

CIMinimumCompositing.inputImage.target: The image to use as a foreground image.

CIAccordionFoldTransition.inputFoldShado.target: A value that specifies the intensity of the shadow in the transition.

CIDissolveTransition.target: Uses a dissolve to transition from one image to another.
